response.sql: WITH account_avg_trans AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) as avg_trans_amount FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), account_region AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 as region, aat.avg_trans_amount FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN account_avg_trans aat ON a.account_id = aat.account_id), region_avg AS (SELECT region, AVG(avg_trans_amount) as region_figure FROM account_region GROUP BY region), all_regions_avg AS (SELECT AVG(region_figure) as all_regions_average FROM region_avg), above_average_regions AS (SELECT r.region, r.region_figure, r.region_figure - a.all_regions_average as exceeds, r.region_figure / a.all_regions_average as ratio FROM region_avg r CROSS JOIN all_regions_avg a WHERE r.region_figure > a.all_regions_average) SELECT * FROM above_average_regions ORDER BY region;
